posts.cooked:
Well hang on… Like I said, we haven’t planned really anything. All we have is the idea. We still need to find a time when we can do this, and we need other things in general, like costumes, sets, actors, script etc. I for sure really wanna do this, but I don’t want to be promising everyone a cameo in the movie, especially if you guys are somewhere else and our filming locations are too far away. But once my friends and I work more things out on this, I’ll let you all know. We’ll probably start writing the script this summer, because I’d rather wait and have more details on Expatriette and her backstory. So starting in May/June, I’ll begin putting this together, and let you know if there’s any way you guys can help. And really, I’d love for you guys to be there and be extras or something. You could even be one of the bad guys: you get to wear a suit and pretend to fire a gun! And I know for sure we’ll need more extras, so for those of you in Indiana, we can probably get you in. Especially because I’d like to make sure that not every character is played by one of my friends or one of their friends, otherwise we’d have a movie where every character looks like they’re 18-20 years old. And I’m also gonna need to find someone who can actually be Expatriette, but again, I’m gonna need to know her general age and such.

I’m also going to have to beg Christopher and the guys to let me use their characters…
